errors.text_span: The categories are arranged in descending order of token count from left to right, except for "Blogs," which is placed last despite having the smallest value.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the categories on the x-axis are arranged in descending order of value. The actual order of categories on the chart is: Administrative (6472), Religion (652), Non-fiction (1889), Fiction (387), Law (354), News (10584), Science (1626), and Blogs (32). This is not a descending order.
